canonicalFindings.title: setPool repoints _pairToken without re-validating the stored custom _primeToPairPath, so a stale path can route the prime->pair swap to the old (wrong) token
canonicalFindings.fileLine: src/dispatchers/Uniboost.sol:124-133 (_setPool); set-time validate :160; stale path used in pool() :219
canonicalFindings.rationale: NEW QA-class finding. Owner-driven, recoverable (rescueERC20 sweeps stranded dust), and self-evident (next pool() reverts/under-funds loudly). No theft, no silent value leak. Borderline Law-3 obvious but worth a QA note because the setter's advertised invariant (path end == pairToken) is silently violated across setPool. Remediation: clear/re-assert _primeToPairPath inside _setPool when the pair token changes.
